constraints.definition: CHECK (((("participationAccessSchemaVersion" = 0) AND ("useParticipationAccess" = false) AND ("participationAccessMethod" = 'EMAIL'::text) AND ("participationTargetScope" = 'ALL'::text) AND ("participationUseOtp" = false) AND ("participationSocialProvider" = 'KAKAO'::text) AND ("restrictDuplicateReplies" = false)) OR (("participationAccessSchemaVersion" = 1) AND ((("useParticipationAccess" = false) AND ("participationAccessMethod" = 'EMAIL'::text) AND ("participationTargetScope" = 'ALL'::text) AND ("participationUseOtp" = false) AND ("participationSocialProvider" = 'KAKAO'::text) AND ("restrictDuplicateReplies" = false)) OR (("useParticipationAccess" = true) AND ((("participationAccessMethod" = 'EMAIL'::text) AND ("participationTargetScope" = ANY (ARRAY['ALL'::text, 'WHITELIST'::text])) AND (("participationTargetScope" = 'WHITELIST'::text) OR ("participationUseOtp" = true)) AND ("participationSocialProvider" = 'KAKAO'::text)) OR (("participationAccessMethod" = 'SOCIAL'::text) AND ("participationTargetScope" = 'ALL'::text) AND ("participationUseOtp" = false) AND ("participationSocialProvider" = ANY (ARRAY['KAKAO'::text, 'NAVER'::text])))))))))
CHECK ((((method = 'EMAIL'::text) AND (provider IS NULL)) OR ((method = 'SOCIAL'::text) AND (provider = ANY (ARRAY['KAKAO'::text, 'NAVER'::text])))))
